relationships.subject: temperature
relationships.evidence_quote: Without exception, we found hyperpolarizing shifts of V1/2 in the range between 5.4 mV (Nav1.6) and 9.5 mV (Nav1.3) with increasing temperature from 15°C to 35°C

relationships.subject: temperature
relationships.evidence_quote: The persistent current was enhanced with lowered temperature.

relationships.subject: Nav1.7/I1461T
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed a strong increase in persistent current for the mutation with a normalized persistent current Ipers of 14.4% ± 1.4% at 15°C for Nav1.7/I1461T and only 2.5% ± 0.3% for WT

key_findings: Warming shifted Nav activation to hyperpolarized potentials; cooling enhanced persistent current, most strongly for Nav1.3.
Nav1.7 IEM mutation effects were enhanced by warmth and PEPD mutation effects by cooling.
